risks.prevention: Keep scope limited to semantics and validation

risks.source_excerpt: | Ambiguous account signs                      | Explicit per-grain policy tables                 | Worked examples and semantic tests | Stop contract freeze           |
| Bank false matching                          | Exact reference policy only                      | Unknown-reference fixtures         | Preserve unallocated exception |
| Schema passes but semantics fail             | Separate semantic validator                      | Adversarial cross-field tests      | Correct contract or validator  |
| Nullable field bypasses `required`           | Conditional non-null schemas                     | Null-boundary fixtures             | Reject the contract            |
| Circular digest definition                   | Exclude digest field explicitly                  | Canonicalization tests             | Block identity freeze          |
| Validator validates only itself              | Independent negative fixtures and mutation tests | Mutant survival                    | Strengthen tests               |
risks.prevention: Independent negative fixtures and mutation tests

risks.source_excerpt: | Documentation drifts                         | Machine-check shared constants and links         | CI consistency job                 | Block merge                    |
| Target score presented as achieved           | Separate target and evidence fields              | Completion validator               | Reject scorecard               |
| Accidental AWS execution                     | Manual-only OIDC and workflow trigger tests      | Actions-run audit                  | Stop and investigate           |
risks.prevention: Manual-only OIDC and workflow trigger tests

risks.source_excerpt: | Partial correction enters main               | One atomic corrective PR                         | Diff and branch checks             | Keep PR draft                  |
| Green PR but failed main                     | Independent main CI required                     | Post-merge workflow                | Part 1 remains incomplete      |

source_reverse_review.method: Every nonblank authority line is requirement/risk-bound or explicitly disposed.
